主要内容: On January 31, 2019, Freshstart Venture Capital Corp., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp., entered into amendments to the Loan Agreement and Note. The amendments extended the payment date under the Loan Agreement, effective as of January 25, 2017, and the Note, effective March 1, 2017. These amendments were made while additional amendments to the Loan Agreement and Note were being negotiated and finalized. The amendments are attached as exhibits and incorporated by reference into the Form 8-K filing. The changes relate to the terms of the Loan Agreement and Note, which are financial agreements between Freshstart Venture Capital Corp. and the U.S. Small Business Administration.
